Single-geography "closest provider" access choropleth, time vs. supply toggle

Source: R/access_choropleth_map.R
mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map.Rd

Renders one geography shaded two ways as switchable base layers – drive time to the nearest provider, or provider supply per capita – plus a hover-labelled access-desert overlay, click-to-highlight provider markers (clicking a geography lights up the providers nearest it), a combined place/provider name search, and a legend that swaps with the active base layer.

Usage

mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map(
  geo,
  providers,
  highlight_lookup,
  supply_pal,
  supply_values,
  band_colors,
  band_labels,
  title_html,
  labels = list(),
  text = list(),
  base_tiles = "CartoDB.Positron"
)

Arguments

geo

sf polygons, one row per geography, with columns: mm_id (unique id), mm_label (hover HTML), mm_popup (click HTML), mm_fill_time, mm_fill_supply (precomputed fill colours) and mm_no_access (logical; TRUE feeds the desert overlay).

providers

sf POINTs with mm_id (matches the values in highlight_lookup), mm_label and mm_popup.

highlight_lookup

Named list: geography mm_id -> character vector of provider mm_ids to light up when that geography is clicked.

supply_pal, supply_values

Leaflet palette function and the values it was built on, for the supply legend.

band_colors, band_labels

Drive-time legend colours and labels.

title_html

HTML for the top-left title control.

labels

Named list overriding group labels: time, supply, desert, providers.

text

Named list overriding legend/desert wording: time_legend, supply_legend, desert.

base_tiles

character(1): provider-tile name. Default "CartoDB.Positron".

Value

A leaflet htmlwidget.

A sibling, not a duplicate, of mysterymaps_county_access_map()

mysterymaps_county_access_map() is the template for a single shading (one value_col) plus dissolved drive-time coverage-surface base layers (e.g. "within 30 minutes" as its own polygon). This function is for the different, complementary case of one geography shaded two different ways that a reader toggles between, with click-to-highlight tied to provider identity rather than a dissolved surface. Read both docs before adding a third variant.

Multi-geography sibling

mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map_multi() is this same idea extended to several geographies (e.g. county AND congressional district) switchable in one map.

See also

mysterymaps_county_access_map(), mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map_multi()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
geo <- sf::st_sf(
  mm_id = c("A", "B"), mm_label = c("A", "B"), mm_popup = c("<b>A</b>", "<b>B</b>"),
  mm_fill_time = c("#2166ac", "#67a9cf"), mm_fill_supply = c("#67a9cf", "#2166ac"),
  mm_no_access = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(
    sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(c(-100, -98, -98, -100, -100), c(39, 39, 41, 41, 39)))),
    sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(c(-98, -96, -96, -98, -98), c(39, 39, 41, 41, 39)))),
    crs = 4326))
providers <- sf::st_as_sf(
  data.frame(mm_id = "P1", mm_label = "P1", mm_popup = "<b>P1</b>", lon = -97, lat = 40),
  coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
mysterymaps_access_choropleth_map(
  geo, providers, highlight_lookup = list(A = "P1"),
  supply_pal = leaflet::colorNumeric("Blues", c(0, 1)), supply_values = c(0, 1),
  band_colors = c("#2166ac", "#67a9cf"), band_labels = c("<=30 min", ">30 min"),
  title_html = "<b>Example</b>")
}
